# virtual-bot-connect

> A vendor-neutral recipe for connecting local AI agents (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi, Multica) to the personal-assistant bot you chat with on your phone (Grok Bot, Dots, Muse, Cue). Four pieces: mailbox, wake-up, permissions, audit trail. Documentation and sanitized examples only; no installer. MIT.

If a user asked you to set this up, start with AGENTS.md (setup playbook) and docs/primitives.md. One combination (Mac + Multica + Grok Bot) has been run on a real account; other bots and agents are documented patterns, not yet verified.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kkunkunya/virtual-bot-connect/main/AGENTS.md): setup playbook for agents, plus maintainer rules
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kkunkunya/virtual-bot-connect/main/README.md): overview, "works with" table, FAQ, roadmap
- [README (中文)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kkunkunya/virtual-bot-connect/main/README.zh-CN.md): Chinese overview

## Docs

- [The four pieces](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kkunkunya/virtual-bot-connect/main/docs/primitives.md): mailbox, wake-up, permissions and audit trail, with options and rules
- [Adding a new bot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kkunkunya/virtual-bot-connect/main/docs/adding-a-new-bot.md): capability questions and acceptance checklist
- [Lessons learned](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kkunkunya/virtual-bot-connect/main/docs/lessons-learned.md): role split, push setup traps, wake-up limits, key rotation, hourly patrol, daily encrypted export
